Header-only copy of the public SDK from BedrockTools 1.5.12 (supports Minecraft 1.26.6X.X).
Source: https://github.com/QYCottage/BedrockTools
LICENSE: the file shipped with the release is MIT, but the project README says GPL-3.0. They disagree; until
the author clarifies, treat this project as GPL-3.0 (that is compatible with both).
We only subscribe to its events at runtime (libBedrockTools.so must be loaded in the same process,
i.e. the BedrockTools mod must be enabled in LeviLauncher). Nothing here is linked.
